name: .308 Cal-151gr Absolute Hammer™

ballisticCoefficients.note: Hammer Bullets: "g7-bc= .185 Calculated from shot drops" (Calculated from shot drops).

note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "A 1-12″ twist rate Absolute Hammer™ that will be fantastic in the 308 Winchester. Imagine 3200 fps in the 308 with a bullet large enough for any of the North American big game. Absolute Hammer™s are designed with an ogive that does not get engraved by the rifling. This results in much lower engraving pressure and consistent bc from rifle to rifle. The resulting low engraving pressure makes it so they do not line up with conventional data. Reloading with Absolutes should be done by experienced re-loaders only."
